body: Founder asked 'can we make 25 character instrument identifiers?' then 'hallucinate a project name for it' then 'unlicense'. Shipped SKULDMARK-25: EIN prefix + 4-char ISO 10383 MIC + 10-char padded ticker + 7-digit zero-padded SEC CIK + 1 base-36 checksum = 25 chars exactly, derived from real fields FatBaby's identity.SecurityRef already tracks rather than an arbitrary serial. New standalone repo, public domain (Unlicense), full test coverage, registered in top-level CLAUDE.md non-workspace table. Not yet wired into any real pipeline.
title: SKULDMARK-25: 25-character instrument identifier format
